reason_by_file.experiments/branch_unit/dynamic/global_l: Generate three deterministic geometry candidates per frozen support/wrap region, solve one legal independent L1 sibling pair, and attach it to the normal L1 plan before downstream hierarchy generation.
reason_by_file.experiments/branch_unit/dynamic/branch_u: Accept the independent L1 flower_wrap role in downstream grammar without compiling it as a support child.
reason_by_file.experiments/branch_unit/dynamic/role_reg: Expose read-only region geometry helpers needed to measure variable width and guide progress without regenerating the R2B plan.
reason_by_file.experiments/branch_unit/dynamic/diagnost: Independently recompute every frozen R2C metric and render curve-over-region evidence.
reason_by_file.tests/branch_unit_R/test_R2C_*: Verify topology, frozen digest consumption, candidate diversity, channel/flower metrics, crossings, bounds, and generation order.
reason_by_file.artifacts/runs/dynamic_branch_R2C_*: Store the candidate inventory, selected pair, replay, metrics, audits, visual evidence, and checkpoint report.
